notes.title: Bug fixes!
notes.content:
Hey all!

I've pushed out fixes for a few bugs people had encountered.  The two major issues were a blank screen on launch in MacOS 10.6, and errors with save games when using non-ascii characters in the windows username.

Let us know in the forums if you encounter any problems!

Bug Fixes:
Issue #903 - fix broken MacOS 10.6 support

Issue #901 - Save Game - European/non-ascii characters in windows username is breaking save games.

Issue #881 - input stuck in mouse_down state when game pauses for
	item get or encounter start

Issue #879 - Keys can be carried over after levels.

- Other small bug fixes

notes.title: Special Edition / Price Drop
notes.content:
Many thanks to everyone who’s taken the time to buy and play [i]Sneaky Sneaky[/i] on Steam!

As a special thank you to everyone who bought early, we've upgraded the current version to the ‘Special Edition’, which will include the awesome soundtrack and a free copy to share with a friend!  Unfortunately, there aren’t as many of you as we’d hoped for and we’re listening to user feedback. After only one day on the store we’ve made the hard decision that we need to drop the price of the game.

Again, thanks so much for checking out our little game, and please let us know what you think.   We’ve created a new thread in the discussion boards [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/259410/discussions/0/617319460843196225/]here[/url].
